messages:
tariq-peopleops: Quick note  we've published two small handbook updates: 1) Remote work expense policy clarified (reimbursable categories + monthly cap), 2) Annual harassment prevention refresher required for all active staff. Please review and ACK by Mon 2026-02-22. Diff: https://internal.redwood/handbook/changes/1764509123

leah.peopleops: TL;DR: expenses now include home office internet partial reimbursement (up to $40/mo) + monitored allowance for peripherals up to $150/year. Harassment refresher is 18m, due 2026-03-10.

emily-benefits: Payroll note: managers, submit any stipend retro requests for Jan/Feb by 2026-02-25 to payroll@redwood. If someone already got a one-off equipment reimbursement this quarter, mark it on the form so we avoid duplicates. Form: https://forms.redwood/expense-stipend.

mike-ops: Are contractors eligible for the internet stipend? We've got 4 contractors on Eng who may ask.

nina-legal: Contractors: stipend is for W-2/UK payroll employees only. Contractors should use their standard expense process. We'll add a sentence to the handbook clarifying this.

sara-peopleops: On training: onboarding-bot will auto-assign the harassment refresher to anyone who hasn't completed it. Managers, please remind new hires to finish within 2 weeks of start.

onboarding-bot: New assignment created: "Annual Harassment Prevention Refresher 2026". Link: https://training.redwood/assign/harassment-2026. Due 2026-03-10.

compliance-bot: Reminder: Course assigned to all active staff. Completion report will be sent to managers on 2026-03-11. Weekly nudges every Tue.

leah.peopleops: I'll host a 10-min drop-in Q&A Wed 9:00am PT to go over the expense categories and the reimbursement flow. Drop questions here beforehand if you'd like them covered.

emily-benefits: Also note: managers approving expenses must attach a short justification for any peripheral >$75. This helps audit trails.

mike-ops: Acked. I'll add a note to the Eng onboarding checklist to avoid confusion.

sara-peopleops: For tracking: please ACK the handbook change in the repo and add any affected contractors to the contractor log if they need special expense handling. We'll export an ACK + completion CSV next Monday.

nina-legal: I'll add a short footnote for EU employees (local VAT/tax rules may affect reimbursements).

leah.peopleops: Thanks all. Reminder: ACK by 2026-02-22 and training complete by 2026-03-10. If you hit edge cases, tag @nina-legal or DM payroll.
